res://Scripts/Content/Definitions/ArmorD.EquipPosition: Authored wearable position for this equipment item. Ring is eligible for Ring1 or Ring2; Trinket is eligible for Trinket1 or Trinket2. Character/class permission is validated separately.
res://Scripts/Content/Definitions/ArmorD.ArmorValue: Raw Armor contributed to the hero's resolved TotalArmor while this item is equipped. Stored and aggregated now; damage mitigation is intentionally not implemented yet.

res://Scripts/Content/Definitions/Shield.ArmorValue: Raw Armor contributed to the hero's resolved TotalArmor while this shield is equipped in Off Hand. Stored and aggregated now; damage mitigation is intentionally not implemented yet.
